sourceState.policy: All dependency/build inputs come from the pinned commit. Unstaged editor-launcher preferences are unrelated and never copied.

dependencies: Committed public TypeScript source and common presets, rebuilt with the exact pinned compiler. Native artifacts retain their build provenance and original notices.

nativeBuild.evidence: Byte-pinned native/public-library inputs, compiler dependency and all translation-unit object checks, linker input hashes and later link time. Excluded editor-launcher preferences are recorded separately. This is local build evidence, not a reproducible-build attestation.
